log.action: Dodge the net and charge Aldric Saltborn.
log.narration: Turn 1 | Day 1, 7:01 pmDexterity saving throwd20: 16 -- successLongsword attackd20: 15 -- successIron Wolf slavers attackd20: 18 -- successThe net snaps through empty air as you hurl yourself beneath its weighted rim.  You surge from the ash and crash into Aldric Saltborn, your longsword biting through his leather guard and drawing a hot sheet of blood.   He reels, but an Iron Wolf slaver drives a short blade through the links beneath your ribs before you smash free.🔊………

log.action: Power Strike Aldric before he recovers.
log.narration: Turn 2 | Day 1, 7:02 pmLongsword attackd20: 18 -- successPower Strike damaged20: 12 -- Aldric Saltborn slainIron Wolf slavers attackd20: 12 -- failedYou put your whole Northlander weight behind the stroke.  Steel shears through Aldric Saltborn’s gorget and buries itself in his throat, cutting his sneer short.   The remaining slavers rush you with hooked spears, but their points shriek across your chainmail.🔊………

log.action: Brace beside the merchants and invoke Shield Wall.
log.narration: Turn 3 | Day 1, 7:03 pmIron Wolf slavers attackd20: 17 -- successIron Wolf slavers damaged20: 5 -- reduced by Shield WallYou plant your boots beside the wagon and lock your sword across your body. The slavers hammer against your braced steel, and one spearhead punches shallowly into your shoulder before your guard turns it aside.    Behind their snarling faces, an iron brand on the dead leader’s belt begins to pulse with a sick green glow.🔊………

log.action: Circle the wagon and flank the nearest slaver.
log.narration: Turn 4 | Day 1, 7:04 pmSprinting checkd20: 17 -- successLongsword attackd20: 16 -- successIron Wolf slavers attackd20: 13 -- failedYou race around the wagon as hooked steel tears splinters from its flank.  The nearest slaver turns too late, and your longsword hacks deep into his thigh.   His fellow lunges across the fallen man, but the spearpoint skates from your mail.  Beneath Aldric Saltborn’s corpse, the branded iron now beats against the earth with the rhythm of a buried heart.🔊………

log.action: Kick the pulsing brand beneath the wagon.
log.narration: Turn 5 | Day 1, 7:05 pmStrength checkd20: 14 -- successYou stamp the iron brand from beneath the corpse and send it spinning under the wagon.  Green fire races across the axle, twisting the wood into a claw that grips the nearest slaver and drags him screaming beneath the wheels. The last attacker recoils from the sorcery, his spear wavering as the wagon begins to pitch toward the trapped merchants.🔊………

log.action: Disarm the last slaver with my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 6 | Day 1, 7:06 pmStrength (Longsword) checkd20: 17 -- successTorvan Urnvale knife attackd20: 8 -- failedYour blade whips beneath the spearhead and tears the weapon from the slaver’s hands.  His torn sleeve exposes Valerius’s coiled-serpent brand, and the old pit-mark tells you who loosed these wolves upon the road. Torvan Urnvale snatches for a belt knife, but the lurching wagon slams him against a wheel as its warped axle groans above the trapped merchants.🔊………

log.action: Shove the pitching wagon away from the merchants.
log.narration: Turn 7 | Day 1, 7:07 pmStrength (Lifting) checkd20: 18 -- successTorvan Urnvale knife attackd20: 14 -- failedYou drive your shoulder beneath the wagon bed and heave until your spine burns like iron in a forge.  The warped wheels grind clear of the merchants, then the wagon crashes onto its side in a storm of ash. Torvan Urnvale darts through the wreckage and slashes for your throat, but his knife rings from your raised longsword.🔊………

log.action: Pin Torvan beneath the overturned wagon.
log.narration: Turn 8 | Day 1, 7:07 pm………

log.action: Seize the dropped spear before Torvan recovers.
log.narration: Turn 9 | Day 1, 7:08 pmDexterity checkd20: 15 -- successIron Wolf slavers attackd20: 16 -- successYou stoop beneath Torvan Urnvale’s grasp and wrench the hooked spear from the ash.   Torvan Urnvale surges upright and rakes his knife across your forearm, spilling blood over the spear shaft.   He crouches behind the shattered wheel, ready to spring again.🔊………

log.action: Use Power Strike to finish Torvan.
log.narration: Turn 10 | Day 1, 7:08 pm………

log.action: Sweep Torvan’s legs with the hooked spear.
log.narration: Turn 11 | Day 1, 7:09 pmStrength (Hooked spear) checkd20: 18 -- successYou hook Torvan Urnvale behind the knees and rip his feet from the earth.  He strikes the ash hard, and your spearhead pins his knife hand beside his face. “The Gilded Cage,” he gasps, while the serpent-mark writhes on his flesh, “beneath Ashenveil.”🔊………

log.action: Sweep Torvan’s legs with the hooked spear.
log.narration: Turn 12 | Day 1, 7:10 pmThe hook catches Torvan Urnvale’s ankles and drags him clear of the wreck. His branded flesh splits, releasing a smoke-serpent whose jaws gape around a furnace-green void. Torvan Urnvale claws backward as the horror coils to strike you, hungry for the blood already wet upon your arm. “Valerius put it inside me!”🔊………

log.action: Demand Torvan yield and explain the brand.
log.narration: Turn 13 | Day 1, 7:11 pmCharisma (Intimidation) checkd20: 14 -- successBrand Wraith attackd20: 15 -- failedYou grind the spear hook against Torvan Urnvale’s shin and bark your demand.  “I yielded! The brand drinks pain, and the Shadow Alchemist can reach through it!” The Brand Wraith lashes at your face, but you wrench aside as its claws rake sparks from your mail.🔊………

log.action: Use Shield Wall and guard my wounded arm.
log.narration: Turn 14 | Day 1, 7:12 pmBrand Wraith attack rolld20: 17 -- successBrand Wraith damage rolld20: 5 -- Shield Wall reduces damage to 2You wrench the hooked spear crosswise and brace its iron shaft against the earth. The Brand Wraith crashes upon that guard, yet one smoking talon curls around the steel and gouges your wounded arm. Cold fire floods the cut as the horror begins dragging itself along the spear toward your throat.🔊………

log.action: Order Torvan to expose the ruptured brand.
log.narration: Turn 15 | Day 1, 7:13 pmBrand Wraith attack rolld20: 11 -- failedTorvan Urnvale claws his tunic aside, baring the split sigil across his ribs. A black tether throbs between the wound and the Brand Wraith, tightening with each beat of his heart. The horror darts to shield that cord, but its talons scrape harmlessly across your braced spearhead.🔊………

log.action: Drop the spear and draw my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 16 | Day 1, 7:14 pmBrand Wraith attack rolld20: 9 -- failedThe hooked spear falls into the ash, and your longsword leaps free with a hard whisper of steel. The Brand Wraith lunges through your opening, but you twist beneath its talons and bring the blade between its smoky coils and Torvan Urnvale’s branded flesh.  The tether pulls taut across your sword edge, quivering like a plucked gut-string.🔊………

log.action: Strike the Brand Wraith with Power Strike.
log.narration: Turn 17 | Day 1, 7:15 pmLongsword attack rolld20: 19 -- successLongsword damage with Power Striked20: 14 -- fatalYou drive the longsword through the taut tether with all your Northlander strength.  The enchanted cord bursts beneath the steel, and your rising stroke cleaves the Brand Wraith from belly to crown.  Its coils collapse into greasy vapor while Torvan Urnvale’s ruptured mark chars dead upon his ribs.🔊………

log.action: Search Aldric Saltborn's corpse.
log.narration: Turn 18 | Day 1, 7:45 pmInvestigation checkd20: 17 -- successYou wrench open Aldric Saltborn’s blood-stiffened coat and probe its hidden seams.  Beneath the lining you find a brass token stamped with a barred fist, a corked vial whose black contents recoil from your touch, and nine gold pieces. Hoofbeats suddenly hammer along the South Road, coming hard from Ashenveil.🔊………

log.action: Question Torvan about the Gilded Cage.
log.narration: Turn 18 | Day 1, 7:45 pmInvestigation checkd20: 17 -- successYou wrench open Aldric Saltborn’s blood-stiffened coat and probe its hidden seams.  Beneath the lining you find a brass token stamped with a barred fist, a corked vial whose black contents recoil from your touch, and nine gold pieces. Hoofbeats suddenly hammer along the South Road, coming hard from Ashenveil.🔊

log.action: Search Aldric Saltborn's corpse.
log.narration: Turn 20 | Day 1, 7:50 pmYour second search finds only slit pockets and clotted cloth. Three riders burst from the South Road, and their tiefling leader reins up with a cocked crossbow aimed at Torvan Urnvale. “Step away from the branded man, Northlander, or I nail you to the corpse.” The other bows swing toward your breast as Bilwick Lochvane’s barbed tail lashes the saddle.🔊………

log.action: Search Aldric Saltborn's corpse.
log.narration: Turn 21 | Day 1, 7:51 pmBilwick Lochvane crossbow attackd20: 13 -- failedYour hand closes on nothing but cold flesh, Aldric Saltborn has yielded all he carried. Bilwick Lochvane fires while you crouch, and the quarrel rings from your raised sword.  His mounted killers spread across the fork, cutting off the road to Ashenveil.🔊………

log.action: Brace the hooked spear and use Shield Wall.
log.narration: Turn 22 | Day 1, 7:52 pmBilwick Lochvane crossbow attackd20: 12 -- failedAshenveil riders attackd20: 18 -- successAshenveil riders damaged20: 4 -- Shield Wall reduces damage to 1You snatch up the hooked spear and drive its butt into the packed earth. Bilwick Lochvane’s quarrel glances from your mail, but a rider’s curved blade chops through your guard. Shield Wall bleeds the stroke of its force, yet steel bites your shoulder and leaves your sword arm numb.🔊………

log.action: Rush Bilwick Lochvane and drag him from the saddle.
log.narration: Turn 23 | Day 1, 7:53 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 17 -- successAshenveil riders attackd20: 10 -- failedYou charge through the drifting ash and jam the spear hook beneath Bilwick Lochvane’s sword belt.  You wrench him from the saddle, and he smashes onto the road as his mount bolts north. A rider slashes at your skull, but the blade whistles past when you drop beside your fallen quarry.🔊………

log.action: Take cover behind the overturned wagon.
log.narration: Turn 24 | Day 1, 7:54 pmDexterity (Sprinting) checkd20: 16 -- successYou sprint for the overturned wagon as bolts hiss past your neck.  You dive behind the shattered bed, and two quarrels punch through the planks without reaching your flesh. Bilwick Lochvane rises beyond the wreck and draws a hooked knife while his riders split toward either flank.🔊………

log.action: Hook Bilwick's ankle from behind the wagon.
log.narration: Turn 25 | Day 1, 7:55 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 16 -- successAshenveil riders attackd20: 12 -- failedThe spear snakes beneath the wagon and catches Bilwick Lochvane above the heel.  You heave, slamming him face-first against the broken wheel as his riders loose shafts into the timber above you.🔊………

log.action: Hook Bilwick's ankle from behind the wagon.
log.narration: Turn 26 | Day 1, 7:56 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 9 -- failedAshenveil riders attackd20: 14 -- failedYou wrench the hook, but Bilwick Lochvane jams his knife into the wheel rim and anchors himself.  His tail lashes around the shaft and nearly tears it from your grip, while a rider’s axe crashes against the wagon frame beside your head.🔊………

log.action: Retreat north while keeping the wagon between me.
log.narration: Turn 27 | Day 1, 8:01 pmDexterity (Sprinting) checkd20: 16 -- successYou back along the north arm while the wagon drinks the riders’ volley.  You reach a steep ash-cut where horses cannot follow without breaking their legs, and Bilwick Lochvane halts his killers to seize Torvan Urnvale instead. “Run, dog. Ashenveil will close its jaws on you soon enough.”🔊………

log.action: Retreat north before the riders pursue.
log.narration: Turn 28 | Day 1, 8:46 pmDexterity (Sprinting) checkd20: 15 -- successYou drive north through the ash, blood pounding beneath your mail.  At a wind-scoured rise you look back and see Bilwick Lochvane’s band hauling Torvan Urnvale toward Ashenveil, while one mounted shape studies the trail of blood you left behind. Ahead, the wild hills swallow the road in darkness.🔊………

log.action: Retreat north before the riders pursue.
log.narration: Turn 29 | Day 1, 8:46 pm………

log.action: Hide and watch the southern road.
log.narration: Turn 30 | Day 1, 9:06 pmDexterity (Stealth) checkd20: 17 -- successYou flatten beneath a shelf of black stone as hoofbeats climb from the south.  Bilwick Lochvane reins onto the rise, finds your blood on the shale, and sends two riders into the northern defile while he turns back toward Ashenveil. “Smoke him out, then bring me his hands.”🔊………

log.action: Follow the northern defile into the wild hills.
log.narration: Turn 31 | Day 1, 10:06 pmWisdom (Navigation) checkd20: 16 -- successYou thread a knife-thin ledge above the defile and let the hunters thunder into the northern waste below.  Their hoofbeats perish beyond the hills, but a western fissure exhales warm air and reveals bootprints descending toward Ashenveil, beside them sprawls an adult hollow-born warrior with his throat crushed inward. From the fissure comes the slow scrape of iron across stone.🔊………

log.action: Enter the western fissure with sword drawn.
log.narration: Turn 32 | Day 1, 10:07 pmChainbound revenant attackd20: 18 -- successYou enter the hot cleft with steel leading, and darkness seals around your shoulders. A corpse chained into the ceiling drops behind you, its crushed throat gaping as sorcerous breath swells its chest.  Its hooked manacle rips across your ribs before you can turn.🔊………

log.action: Search the hollow-born warrior's corpse.
log.narration: Turn 33 | Day 1, 10:08 pmChainbound revenant attackd20: 11 -- failedThe hollow-born warrior lies outside the fissure, beyond the revenant’s swinging chain. You lunge for the mouth, but the dead thing drops between you and the corpse, its manacle gouging sparks from your sword.  The chain coils for another murderous stroke.🔊………

log.action: Brace and sever the revenant’s swinging chain.
log.narration: Turn 34 | Day 1, 10:09 pmStrength attackd20: 19 -- successStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 13 -- failedYou lock your boots against the stone and catch the chain upon your sword’s edge.  Steel bursts apart, and the revenant crashes from the ceiling in a storm of rust. Its dead hands seize your ankle, dragging its crushed face toward your flesh as you strain against its grip.🔊………

log.action: Hack through the hands gripping my ankle.
log.narration: Turn 35 | Day 1, 10:10 pmLongsword attackd20: 17 -- successChainbound revenant attackd20: 12 -- failedYour sword shears through the revenant’s wrists and bites deep into its breastbone.   Black sinew snaps, yet the severed hands remain clamped around your ankle while the revenant lunges with its splintered forearms.  You wrench aside, and bone-shards screech across your mail.🔊………

log.action: Drive my longsword through the revenant’s breastbone.
log.narration: Turn 36 | Day 1, 10:11 pmLongsword attackd20: 18 -- successYou ram the longsword home with both hands, and the point punches through rotten spine into the rock.   The corpse bucks once, then hangs slack upon your blade as green fire drains from its eyes. Beyond it, a bronze gate grinds open by itself, breathing incense and grave-cold air from the passage toward Ashenveil.🔊………

log.action: Drive my longsword through the revenant’s breastbone.
log.narration: Turn 37 | Day 1, 10:12 pmYour sword is already buried to the hilt, and no second death waits within that husk. You wrench the steel free as a deep gong rolls beyond the bronze gate, followed by bootfalls climbing from the buried road. The brass token against your mail turns hot.🔊………

log.action: Drive my longsword through the revenant’s breastbone.
log.narration: Turn 38 | Day 1, 10:13 pmYour thrust grinds dead flesh against basalt, and nothing answers. The approaching tread stops as an adult dwarf woman steps through the bronze gate, her horn hammer resting against one mailed shoulder.  “Corva Emberveil guards this road. Surrender the arena token, or I wake every corpse beneath this ridge.”🔊………

log.action: Retreat through the eastern opening into Cinder Maw Defile.
log.narration: Turn 39 | Day 1, 10:15 pmDexterity (Sprinting) checkd20: 14 -- successYou spring east as Corva Emberveil hurls her hammer after you.  The weapon smashes sparks from the passage wall, but you burst into the open ravine before she can bar your flight. Behind you, Corva strikes the gate once, and hidden chains begin hauling something vast beneath the ridge.🔊………

log.action: Hurl the severed chain to entangle Corva.
log.narration: Turn 40 | Day 1, 10:16 pmYour hand closes on empty air, for the broken links lie inside the fissure behind Corva Emberveil. She slams her horn hammer against the bronze gate, and the ravine floor erupts beneath your boots. Three ash-packed dead claw from the shale and close upon you with stone teeth.🔊………

log.action: Power Strike the nearest ash-packed dead.
log.narration: Turn 41 | Day 1, 10:17 pmLongsword attack with Power Striked20: 17 -- successAsh-packed dead attackd20: 10 -- failedYou swing from the hip, pouring every cord of muscle into the blow.  The blade cleaves one dead thing from collar to ribs and hurls its packed ash across the ravine.  The others rake at your mail, but their stone claws skid from the iron rings.🔊………

log.action: Sprint up the southern throat toward Ashen Scar Overlook.
log.narration: Turn 42 | Day 1, 10:37 pmDexterity (Sprinting) checkd20: 16 -- successAsh-packed dead attackd20: 13 -- failedYou race up the southern throat while claws hammer the shale behind you.  One corpse lunges for your heel, but its fingers close upon blowing ash as you gain the overlook.  The dead halt below, their skulls tilted toward Corva Emberveil’s distant horn call, while Ashenveil’s furnace glow stains the southern horizon.🔊………

log.action: Sprint up the southern throat toward Ashen Scar Overlook.
log.narration: Turn 43 | Day 1, 10:38 pmFarindel Quellvane crossbow attackd20: 12 -- failedYour charge crests the rise, but a black-fletched quarrel snaps against your chainmail.  An adult elf steps from the southern rocks, crossbow leveled while an arena token gleams upon his throat. “Corva wants the brass key, Northlander, but I will settle for your corpse.”🔊………

log.action: Dive behind the southern rocks before he reloads.
log.narration: Turn 44 | Day 1, 10:39 pmDexterity (Sprinting) checkd20: 16 -- successFarindel Quellvane crossbow attackd20: 15 -- failedYou fling yourself behind the jagged stone as Farindel Quellvane claws back his bowstring.  His bolt bursts against the rock, showering your cheek with chips, then his boots grind close along the far side.🔊………

log.action: Lunge around the rock and grapple Farindel.
log.narration: Turn 45 | Day 1, 10:40 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 18 -- successYou burst around the rock and seize Farindel Quellvane before he can level the crossbow.  Your arm locks across his chest, crushing the weapon between your bodies, but his free hand snakes toward a knife at his belt.🔊………

log.action: Break Farindel’s knife arm against the rocks.
log.narration: Turn 46 | Day 1, 10:41 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 17 -- successYou wrench Farindel Quellvane sideways and smash his forearm upon the stone.  Bone cracks beneath your grip, and his knife tumbles into the ash as he snarls through the pain.🔊………

log.action: Kick the fallen knife beyond Farindel’s reach.
log.narration: Turn 47 | Day 1, 10:42 pmDexterity checkd20: 13 -- successFarindel Quellvane unarmed attackd20: 18 -- successYou hook the knife with your boot and send it skittering over the lip of the rise.  Farindel Quellvane drives his brow into your mouth, and blood floods across your teeth.🔊………

log.action: Pin Farindel beneath my weight and interrogate him.
log.narration: Turn 48 | Day 1, 10:43 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 19 -- successStrength (Intimidation) checkd20: 17 -- successYou drive Farindel Quellvane face-first against the stone and crush his ruined arm beneath your knee.  “Who brews the elixir, and where?”  “Beneath the fighting floor, in the drowned cistern,” he gasps, as the token at his throat begins to sear his flesh.🔊………

log.action: Knock Farindel unconscious with the crossbow.
log.narration: Turn 49 | Day 1, 10:44 pmCrossbow stock attackd20: 18 -- successYou wrench the crossbow free and club Farindel Quellvane across the temple.  Blood leaps from his brow, but the elf remains conscious beneath you, twisting with cold fury.  The heated token hisses against his throat as green light crawls into his eyes.🔊………

log.action: Choke Farindel unconscious before the green light spreads.
log.narration: Turn 50 | Day 1, 10:45 pmStrength (Grappling) checkd20: 16 -- successYou clamp your forearm beneath Farindel Quellvane’s jaw and bear down until his struggles cease.
